'''Tom Lischke Mean Little Garrison''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tom Lischke]]
* '''Published:''' October 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Dagobah: Cave]]
* '''Strategy:''' Mean Little Garrison
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Mean Little Garrison Lischke DS.txt |Download]]
